title: Tiny and Only Burn for 1 Hour
text: Tiny and Only Burn for 1 Hour. These are so tiny and they only burn for about an hour. I buy floating candles 2 or 3 times a year and candles that are only slightly bigger always burn for 4-6 hours. These are just silly.
